findings.repro: Source-only repro specification, NOT executed: pass two objects of the actual DTO shape {created_at: ISO timestamp, power_w: 7000, energy_added: 1/2, battery_heater_on: true}. sample.ts is undefined, timed/filter results are empty, four heater metrics are missing, chart empty, phase panel says no usable telemetry despite successful nonempty query.
findings.fix: Create one narrowly owned contract integration after deciding an authentic heater-power source/capability. Align timestamp and actual SI fields explicitly, respecting the endpoint kWh conversion. Do not estimate watts from a boolean/temperature, fake samples, or silently assume energy_added is Wh. If heater power is unavailable, disclose unsupported evidence instead of claiming no telemetry.
findings.dedup: Exact identifiers searched across existing Phase6 reports: no match. Prior audit-page-085 checked declarations only and explicitly did not inspect handlers. Existing nested-error root does not repair these success-payload semantics.
findings.mechanism: The actual GET route serializes chargeTelemetryRow with created_at, merged power_w, and energy_added in kWh. It emits neither ts nor battery_heater_power_w nor separate AC/DC W/Wh fields. useChargeTelemetry only applies safeArray; request camelCaseKeys adds naming aliases, not semantic field mappings. Analyzer and presentation parse sample.ts, so every real declared DTO row has an invalid timestamp and is discarded. The heater power signal is not mapped or serialized at all; BatteryHeaterOn and temperatures cannot establish heater watts.

findings.repro: Static arithmetic, NOT executed: t=0,60,120 seconds, heater=3000 W each; cumulative AC=null,0,100 Wh; DC=null each. Heater numerator=100 Wh over 120 seconds, denominator=100 Wh over only final60 seconds, displayed share100%; same-interval heater energy would be50 Wh/share50%. All heater evidence is complete, so missing-heater warning cannot disclose the denominator mismatch. This conditional arithmetic defect is currently masked by CTT-S01 for the declared endpoint.
findings.fix: Preserve raw readings and existing methods; expose matched source intervals/coverage and calculate comparable numerator/denominator or mark share unavailable when scope cannot be established. Cover absent first/last counters separately.

findings.mechanism: A completed run ends at its last same-state sample, while the next run starts at the first changed-state sample. Every inter-run interval is omitted. The documented transition boundary is the newly observed sample timestamp, not the previous timestamp. KPI midpoint on-time still includes those intervals.

candidates.detail: Integration/on-time extrapolate through gaps beyond300s; Coverage badge separately reports them but does not restrict integrals. Existing zero-fill behavior is explicitly disclosed. Whether additional low-coverage uncertainty policy is required needs specialist review, not silent algorithm replacement.

Partial AC/DC fields are summed with missing channel0; monotonic sum can hide a single channel reset, and zero cumulative difference falls back to power. Need actual signal invariants before classifying as physical-domain errors. Negative heater clamp is explicit existing policy/test, not a sign regression.

Verify Quick view exposes hidden start/end/algorithm state at all narrow allocated widths, keyboard focus and help/export/legend controls, forced colors, contrast and200% text. Authored mobile test is not mounted/native evidence.

Heater energy is a sampled numerical estimate, not a metered loss/pack-temperature rise or net battery-energy measurement. No temperature is used by ThermalTaxSample or analyzer. Page subtitle implies warming-vs-range but no range/temperature model proves that interpretation; review physical explanatory copy with source owner. Do not derive temperature or fabricate heater draw from backend booleans.

coverage.unknownAndZero: heaterEvidence requires at least two distinct finite heater timestamps for integral, one for peak. Null metrics remain unknown, finite recorded0 is a value when evidence exists. Missing readings labeled incomplete zero-fill estimates; phase unknown label preserved. Zero/unknown delivered energy produces unavailable share; nonzero fallback policy candidate separate.

coverage.trust: Independent historical history/telemetry useDataState. Only fatalError replaces its source content; retained failures/offline keep data with warning/retry. Stats retain missing/loading slots, chart and phase shells independently handle loading/fatal/empty/paused. Summary model trust does not establish physical temperature measurements.
coverage.observedVersusModeled: Heater Wh and on-time derived from power samples; cumulative denominator preferred, power-integral fallback labeled. No temperature/range prediction is implemented. Actual mounted endpoint supplies temperatures/boolean but no heater watts; cannot infer watts.
